The '''RIC-series droid''' was a general purpose [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] manufactured by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]] They were in operation during the last centuries of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:RIC920Rickshaw-FF66.png|thumb|left|250px|A RIC-series Rickshaw Droid]]
The RIC-series was a reliable, yet unsophisticated, labor automaton, roughly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in shape, and propelled by a pair of disc-mounted treads that could reach speeds of 65 [[Kilometer_per_hour/Legends|kilometers per hour]]. The arms ended in three fingered gripper hands that could bend metal but were still dexterous enough for delicate repair work. The design remained unchanged for centuries. RIC [[Droid/Legends|droids]] possessed limited artificial intelligence, with only rudimentary programming to carry out their tasks. They could converse in two languages, usually [[Galactic_Basic_Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[Binary/Legends|binary]], but other language skillware could be swapped in.<ref name="NEGD" />

==History==
[[File:RIC-920-AOTC.png|thumb|right|250px|ES-PSA in Mos Espa on Tatooine.]]
RIC droids found fame as [[Nuna-ball/Legends|nuna-ball]] players<ref name="NEGD" /> during the leadup to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]; the Serv-O-Droid team beat [[AccuTronics/Legends|AccuTronics]]' [[B1-series worker droid|B1]] team in a [[Nuna-Ball League]] game on [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]. The agility, speed and endurance of the RIC droid team proved effective against the stronger B1 side. These games were popular among the patrons of several [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] nightclubs, including the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander]].

Other RIC-series droids found work as rickshaw drivers on [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] worlds such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], including [[ES-PSA]] who worked in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].

==Behind the scenes==
The RIC-series droid is referred to as an '''ES-PSA droid''' in the [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] of ''Attack of the Clones''.
